documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Bulge in the right groin since sometime last fall, bigger by the end of the day and with lifting, goes back in when he lies down. Ache after carrying lumber. No nausea, no change in bowels, never stuck out and stayed out. Otherwise usual self.
O: Vitals per flowsheet. Standing: soft right inguinal bulge with cough impulse, reduces easily, nontender. Left side no hernia. Testes normal. Heart irregular, rate controlled. Lungs clear.
A/P:
1. Right inguinal hernia, reducible, symptomatic with work. Refer to general surgery for elective repair. Warned about signs of incarceration - pain, firm bulge that won't go back, vomiting - go to the ED.
2. AF on warfarin - INR today. If surgery is planned, we'll manage the hold here.
3. T2DM - A1c today; sugars running a little higher this winter. No change yet.
4. HTN, CKD 3a - stable, BMP.
5. Still smoking; advised that quitting helps healing after surgery too.

documents.body: Saw the surgeon today. They want to fix it on July 8. They said you would tell me what to do with the coumadin before. They did not give me any papers except the date.

documents.body: Thanks Mr. Dupuis. We'll see you in late June for a pre-op check and set the exact warfarin plan then - usually the last dose is about five days before. Don't change anything until we talk. I've asked our staff to request the surgeon's consult note.

documents.title: Pre-operative Evaluation
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Pre-op visit for elective right inguinal hernia repair 7/8/2025 with outside general surgery. Consult note never arrived despite two requests; details from patient.

Functional capacity good - climbs ladders, carries lumber, no chest pain or dyspnea with it. No syncope. No prior anesthesia problems with gallbladder surgery or the femur repair.

Meds: warfarin 5 mg nightly, metoprolol tartrate 50 BID, amlodipine 5 daily, glargine 20 units qhs. NKDA.

Exam: BP and HR per flowsheet. Irregularly irregular, rate controlled, no murmur. Lungs clear. Reducible right inguinal hernia.

Data: INR 2.5 today. CBC and BMP drawn. ECG: AF, rate controlled, no acute changes.

Assessment: proceeding to low-risk outpatient surgery; no further cardiac testing needed.

Plan:
- Warfarin: last dose the evening of 7/2. No bridging. Resume usual 5 mg the evening of surgery if the surgeon is comfortable, otherwise the next day. INR check about a week after.
- Metoprolol and amlodipine: take the morning of surgery with a sip of water.
- Glargine: usual dose; check sugar on waking and bring the meter.
- Smoking: stop at least the day of surgery; ideally longer.
Note faxed to surgeon's office with today's INR.

conditions.label: Risk of medication error due to look-alike drug confusion (LASA)

documents.title: Operative and anesthesia summary, hernia repair
documents.author: general surgery
documents.body:
Outpatient surgery summary - date of service 7/8/2025.
Patient: 68-year-old man. Procedure: repair of right inguinal hernia under general anesthesia. Allergies: NKDA.
Relevant history: hypertension, type 2 diabetes on insulin, chronic atrial fibrillation on warfarin (held 5 days per PCP plan; baseline INR 2.5 on 6/24), CKD stage 3.
Anesthesia: pre-induction BP 145/90. Surgical team asked for an IV antihypertensive bolus before induction. While drawing up, the anesthesiologist stopped on recognizing that the esmolol and ephedrine vials on the cart were near-identical in appearance and stored next to each other. Both vials checked against labels; correct agent confirmed before anything was drawn or given. No medication error reached the patient. Event filed with hospital safety reporting; patient flagged at risk for look-alike/sound-alike medication error for future anesthetics.
Operative course: uncomplicated repair. EBL minimal. Extubated in OR, uneventful recovery.
Disposition: discharged home same day with wife. Surgeon agrees with resuming warfarin this evening. Follow-up with surgery clinic as needed; PCP for INR.

documents.title: Post-op call
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Called pt day after hernia repair. Sore at incision, taking acetaminophen only - reminded no ibuprofen or naproxen with warfarin and his kidneys. Took his usual warfarin last night per surgeon. No bleeding through dressing, voiding fine, eating. He mentioned the anesthesia team told him they 'caught two look-alike bottles' before giving him anything; asked him to let us know if any summary comes home with him. INR set for 7/17.

documents.title: Anticoagulation check after surgery
documents.author: RN
documents.body: INR 1.7, expected 9 days after resuming from a 5-day hold. No bleeding, incision healing. Per PCP: continue 5 mg nightly, no extra dose, recheck in 12 days.

documents.title: Post-operative Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Two weeks out from right inguinal hernia repair. Pain gone, no longer needs acetaminophen. No lifting over 10 lb per surgeon until 6 weeks - he's grumbling.
Operative summary arrived 7/10: uncomplicated repair. Of note the anesthesia team recorded a near miss with look-alike esmolol and ephedrine vials before induction, caught before any drug was given; added LASA medication-error risk to his problem list so it travels with future surgical paperwork.
Exam: incision clean, healing, no hematoma, no recurrence with cough. Heart irregular, rate controlled.
Plan: INR next week. Resume normal activity at 6 weeks.

documents.title: Anticoagulation check
documents.author: RN
documents.body: INR 2.3, back in range. Continue 5 mg nightly. Back to 5-week checks.

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Wellness visit. Turned 69 last week. Recovered fully from the July hernia repair and back to light building work. No falls. PHQ-2 negative. Lives with wife; proxy on file.

Problems: AF on warfarin, INRs steady since the post-op dip; HTN controlled; T2DM on glargine 20, A1c crept up last spring; CKD 3a; LASA medication-error risk noted from surgery. Eye exam August, no retinopathy.

Exam: irregularly irregular, controlled rate. Lungs clear. Healed right groin incision, no recurrence. Feet: sensation intact, pulses present. No edema.

Plan: yearly labs; flu shot today; COVID vaccine at next INR visit; lung CT ordered for October. Tobacco: still a pack a day, advised again, he declines medication or counseling.

reports.study: Low-dose CT chest for lung cancer screening
reports.text: Indication: annual lung cancer screening, current smoker. Technique: low-dose CT chest without IV contrast. Comparison: 10/8/2024. Findings: no lung nodules. Lungs clear. No consolidation or effusion. Heart normal in size. No lymphadenopathy. Upper abdomen: cholecystectomy clips.
reports.conclusion: Lung-RADS 1, negative. Next annual screen in 12 months.

documents.body: INR checked, reviewed. No bleeding. Same dose. 2025-26 COVID vaccine given R deltoid. Told him his lung CT was negative again.
